summary: Achieving financial success with artificial intelligence requires **mastering a complete toolkit of technologies rather than simply collecting isolated tools**. The source outlines a progression from basic language models, known as **the hammer**, to automated workflows functioning as **the screwdriver**, and finally to autonomous agentic systems acting as **the power drill**. To transform these capabilities into profit, individuals must act as **strategic orchestrators who focus entirely on solving meaningful customer problems** rather than merely selling the underlying technology. Ultimately, wealth comes from **delivering valuable solutions and fixing real-world pain points**, using artificial intelligence merely as a means to execute the work efficiently.
